import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    valid_species = ['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo']
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.title()
    df = df[df['species'].isin(valid_species)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    averages = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return averages
